title: Network pharmacology and experimental validation reveal the therapeutic effect and chemosensitization mechanism of brusatol against oral squamous cell carcinoma.
authors: Xue, Danfeng; Li, Wei; Yu, Fei; Jiang, Qingkun; Yu, Hui; Li, Xin; Qiu, Jiaxuan; Niu, Guangliang
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过网络药理学和分子对接探讨苦木素增强口腔鳞癌顺铂敏感性的机制，核心是NRF2抗氧化通路，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Brusatol (BR) is a quassinoid from the traditional Chinese herb Brucea javanica, widely used for its anti-inflammatory and anti-tumor properties. This study aimed to investigate the molecular mechanisms through which BR enhances cisplatin (CDDP) sensitivity in oral squamous cell carcinoma (OSCC). Network pharmacology and molecular docking were used to prioritize candidate targets and pathways. Cell viability, clonogenic growth, apoptosis, ROS accumulation, and NRF2/HO-1/NQO1 signaling were evaluated using CCK-8, colony formation, Annexin V/PI flow cytometry, AO/EB staining, MitoSOX Red staining, and Western blotting. The synergistic efficacy of BR with CDDP was analyzed using the Chou-Talalay method, while NAC and tBHQ were used to assess the functional roles of ROS and NRF2, respectively. Antitumor efficacy was further examined in a CAL27/CDDP xenograft model. Network pharmacology identified NFE2L2 (encoding NRF2) as a core hub target and highlighted ROS-related signaling pathways. BR inhibited OSCC cell viability and synergistically enhanced CDDP cytotoxicity. BR/CDDP cotreatment reduced NRF2 nuclear accumulation and HO-1/NQO1 expression while increasing mitochondrial ROS accumulation. In vivo, BR/CDDP cotreatment inhibited xenograft growth and decreased Ki-67, NRF2, HO-1, and NQO1 expression. These findings indicate that BR enhances CDDP sensitivity in OSCC by disrupting NRF2/HO-1/NQO1 antioxidant pathway and promoting ROS-associated apoptosis.
abstract_zh: Brusatol (BR) 是从传统中草药鸦胆子 (Brucea javanica) 中提取的一种苦木素类化合物，因其抗炎和抗肿瘤特性而被广泛使用。本研究旨在探讨BR增强口腔鳞状细胞癌 (oral squamous cell carcinoma, OSCC) 对顺铂 (cisplatin, CDDP) 敏感性的分子机制。采用网络药理学和分子对接 (molecular docking) 来优先筛选候选靶点和通路。通过CCK-8、集落形成、Annexin V/PI流式细胞术、AO/EB染色、MitoSOX Red染色和Western blotting评估细胞活力、克隆形成、凋亡、ROS积累以及NRF2/HO-1/NQO1信号通路。使用Chou-Talalay方法分析BR与CDDP的协同效应，同时使用NAC和tBHQ分别评估ROS和NRF2的功能作用。在CAL27/CDDP异种移植模型中进一步检验了抗肿瘤疗效。网络药理学鉴定出NFE2L2（编码NRF2）为核心枢纽靶点，并突出显示了ROS相关信号通路。BR抑制OSCC细胞活力，并协同增强CDDP的细胞毒性。BR/CDDP联合处理降低了NRF2核积累和HO-1/NQO1表达，同时增加了线粒体ROS积累。在体内，BR/CDDP联合处理抑制了异种移植瘤生长，并降低了Ki-67、NRF2、HO-1和NQO1的表达。这些发现表明，BR通过破坏NRF2/HO-1/NQO1抗氧化通路并促进ROS相关凋亡，从而增强OSCC对CDDP的敏感性。
